outline: 以技術觀點，配合環境法令之管理架構，本課程主要講授有害物質的毒性、危害性及對環境污染的影響。此包括前處理、中間處理技術、最終處置及其相對應的管理方法。
schedule:

Definition and Characteristics of Hazardous Material and Wastes
Toxicology
Treatment Technologies
Hazardous Waste Treatment and Technologies
Groundwater and Soil
Drinking and Waste Water
Hazardous Air Pollutants
Environmental Assessment & Management
Workplace Monitoring
Personal Protective Equipment
Workplace Safety
Management of Radiation Exposure
Administrative Requirements
Special Topics
Treatment on Dioxin-contained Wastes
Hazardous Air Pollutants for Indoor Air Quality Management
VOCs Emission from Restaurants and Industris
Sources of Hg in Incineration and Hospitals
